description: Describe one image or one clip in plain language; Corent picks image or video, the model, shape and duration and makes it. max_cost_cents is a required ceiling: above it nothing is made. Set quality "best" only when the user asks for the best quality. Videos return a job id for get_job. A story with several characters or over about 30 seconds is a film: use plan_film.

intent.description: What you want, in natural language

max_cost_cents.description: Spend ceiling in cents for this one generation. Corent refuses if the estimate is higher.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model.

name: create
title: Create (plan + generate, budget-capped)
